title: Samuel’s Farewell Address

questions.question: What did Samuel ask the people to witness against him?
options: Whose ox/donkey have I taken? Whom have I defrauded?
Did I not lead you well?
questions.correctAnswer: Whose ox/donkey have I taken? Whom have I defrauded?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:3 (ESV): "Here I am; testify against me... Whose ox have I taken? Or whose donkey have I taken? Or whom have I defrauded?"

questions.question: Did the people find any fault in Samuel?
options: No, you have not defrauded us or oppressed us
questions.correctAnswer: No, you have not defrauded us or oppressed us
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:4 (ESV): "They said, 'You have not defrauded us or oppressed us or taken anything from any man's hand.'"

questions.question: What weather sign did Samuel call for during wheat harvest?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:17 (ESV): "Is it not wheat harvest today? I will call upon the LORD, that he may send thunder and rain..."

questions.question: Why was the thunder and rain significant?
options: It showed their wickedness in asking for a king
questions.correctAnswer: It showed their wickedness in asking for a king
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:17 (ESV): "...And you shall know and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in the sight of the LORD, in asking for yourselves a king."

questions.question: What did Samuel encourage the people to do despite their sin?
options: Do not turn aside from following the Lord, but serve Him with all your heart
questions.correctAnswer: Do not turn aside from following the Lord, but serve Him with all your heart
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:20 (ESV): "...Do not be afraid; you have done all this evil. Yet do not turn aside from following the LORD..."

questions.question: Samuel mentioned God sending which leaders to deliver them?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:11 (ESV): "And the LORD sent Jerubbaal and Barak and Jephthah and Samuel and delivered you..." (Note: Some manuscripts say Bedan or Samson instead of Barak).

questions.question: Who did Samuel say was their true King?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:12 (ESV): "...No, but a king shall reign over us, when the LORD your God was your king."

questions.question: Samuel said he would not sin against the Lord by ceasing to do what?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:23 (ESV): "Moreover, as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD by ceasing to pray for you..."

questions.question: If they still did wickedly, what would happen?
options: You shall be swept away, both you and your king
questions.correctAnswer: You shall be swept away, both you and your king
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:25 (ESV): "But if you still do wickedly, you shall be swept away, both you and your king."

questions.question: Who is Jerubbaal?
questions.explanation: Jerubbaal is another name for Gideon (Judges 6:32).

questions.question: What prompted the people to ask for a king according to Samuel in this chapter?
options: When you saw that Nahash the king of the Ammonites came against you
questions.correctAnswer: When you saw that Nahash the king of the Ammonites came against you
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:12 (ESV): "And when you saw that Nahash the king of the Ammonites came against you, you said to me, 'No, but a king shall reign over us...'"

questions.question: For the Lord will not forsake his people, for his ______ sake.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:22 (ESV): "For the LORD will not forsake his people, for his great name's sake..."

questions.question: Why has it pleased the Lord to make you a people for himself?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:22 (ESV): "...because it has pleased the LORD to make you a people for himself."

questions.question: Samuel said, "I have walked before you from my youth until this day." What does this emphasize?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:2 (ESV): Context implies integrity and witness.

questions.question: Who sent Moses and Aaron?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 12:6 (ESV): "And Samuel said to the people, 'The LORD is witness, who appointed Moses and Aaron...'"

key_verse_text: Only fear the LORD and serve him faithfully with all your heart. For consider what great things he has done for you. (ESV)
